The '''Dressel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellians]]. It also contained a [[Ore/Legends|mineral]]-rich [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], which was first [[Mining/Legends|mined]] by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] interests after their [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] charted the system circa [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]]. Around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], both Dressel and the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt came under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control. The occupation of Dressel was particularly costly for the Empire, thanks to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-supported Dressellian resistance movement.
